constructor.title: Mehmonlar uchun QR
constructor.subtitle: Stol, stoyka yoki plakat uchun chiroyli maket tayyorlang. Mehmon formasi havolasini o‘zimiz qo‘shamiz.

text.title: Karta matni
text.defaultCaption: Nimani yaxshilash yoki kimni maqtash kerakligini yozing.

context.title: Kontekst
context.hint: Har doim QR ichiga qo‘shiladi va murojaat qayerdan kelganini tushunishga yordam beradi.

sticker.name: Stiker
sticker.description: Kichik nakleyka uchun. Faqat QR va kod ichidagi logotip.

table.name: Stol uchun
table.description: Stol, menyu holderi yoki kutish joyi uchun asosiy format.

stand.name: Stoyka
stand.description: Kassa, bar yoki resepshendagi akril holder uchun.

poster.name: Plakat
poster.description: Kirish, devor yoki navbat yonidagi ko‘rinadigan joy uchun.
